args: Request u0 on an exposed interior package-top patch, and c0,c1 on supporting counter outside the opposing long sides. Check package identity, unchanged support and whether the hand is actually empty/open. Do not invent hidden sidewalls. On retry use different valid patches or the other view. Restart after ineffective descent: request separated interior top samples u1,u2. Return the two supplied physical end-corner pixels in reference order, or []/unknown if occluded. Independently assess current-pose closure (side placement/interference, NO descent) and a 12 mm straight upward OPEN-hand retreat at unchanged orientation. Unknown closure must not veto a clear retreat. Assess contact without certifying hidden clearance or diagnosing controller physics; code checks metric margins.

result.explanation: The visible cream package is on the counter and matches the supplied reference landmarks. The hand is visibly open, with no retained package. Current-pose closure and contact remain unresolved because the relevant proximal interfaces are self-occluded, not because an external obstruction is observed. Independently, the 12 mm straight upward open-hand retreat at unchanged orientation appears clear.

parameters.notes: End corners are returned in reference order: image-right then image-left at the exposed top-face end, not the outer dark rim. Retry samples u0,u1,u2 use different, widely separated, noncollinear interior top patches. c0,c1 are visible counter patches outside opposing long sides. Current placement agrees with supplied frame-144 observations; no earlier image is available for direct temporal comparison. Hidden long-side walls are not established. Closure assessment includes no descent. Retreat assessment is independent and local, not a hidden-clearance certificate. Ineffective descent does not establish contact or its cause; metric margins remain for code to check.
